entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer with multi-level support for User, Session, and Agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes a custom vector graph engine and hybrid RAG search. It provides automated fact extraction and user profile maintenance with connectors for Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that uses the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing. It employs L0/L1/L2 tiered loading layers to provide observable retrieval with directory-browsing trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for Hermes Agents provides synthesized answers featuring citations and gap analysis. It supports multi-user scoping for team institutional memory and creates typed edges without requiring LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system supports long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents and is accessible via Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a context tree using git-like version control via brv vc commit, branch, and merge. It features an interactive TUI and REPL interface with sub-100ms retrieval across 4 non-LLM tiers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system includes vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context using local infrastructure like Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers, including Pi and MCP clients, and includes CLI tools for task investigation.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a SQLite-backed message store to build depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG. It provides agent tools for searching and expanding compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer manages identity, memory, and secrets to provide portable state across Hermes Agent and various MCP clients. It features local custody of SQLite and workspace files, achieving a 97.6% average accuracy on LongMemEval.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store memory as plain-text. It provides zero-cost search and supports Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It utilizes hybrid retrieval through BM25 and vector search and integrates via MCP and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool accelerates long context LLM inference through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: A durable, file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is distributed as a five-package plugin family, including a Hermes adapter and an MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every recall. It includes built-in contradiction tracking and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp and functions as an MCP-native server.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets per query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory solution stores data as inspectable Markdown files to allow users to use an Obsidian vault as a source of truth. It utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead through local BM25 tool ranking and keyword selection. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to load only necessary context, potentially reducing prompt tokens by 94%. It operates locally without hosted services and exposes context as an MCP server.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes an embedded .lbdb graph database to manage memories with a built-in 1-10 importance ranking system. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Designed as a pull-model episodic memory provider, this plugin features an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking all memory operations. It distinguishes itself by supporting immediate, permanent event deletion to prevent old data from influencing future recall.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox, offering specific tools for searching, updating, and remembering agent state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server allows Hermes agents to manage financial transactions using USDC and stablecoins across various chains including EVM, Solana, and TON. It functions as a specialized memory and utility layer for agents that need to programmatically charge for or pay for API services.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides a self-organizing long-term memory system for Hermes agents. It includes configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This security-focused provider implements AES-256-GCM encryption at rest for agent memory by default. It supports multiple indexing methods, including HNSW and FM-index, and can be deployed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin focuses on local capability indexing and routing through five native tools for managing local artifacts. It features a proactive router skill and an opt-in process for automatic tool-OKF generation to streamline agent integration.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This memory provider offers a suite of 17 tools for knowledge graph traversal and hybrid search combining BM25, vector, and graph methods. It maintains context integrity during message compression through automatic context checkpointing.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: Specializing in private local code repositories, this plugin enables semantic and literal code search directly over localhost. It supports grounded Q&A by providing specific file-and-line citations for the information it retrieves.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills and utilizes a subagent-driven-development methodology for task execution. It includes dedicated phases for brainstorming and design refinement to support effective software development.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first prototyping system supports exports for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 formats. It is compatible with local CLI executables and various coding agents, including Hermes Agent, and features automation and plugin capabilities.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It offers clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript to manage ingested data.

entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility performs audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass detection process. It is compatible with Hermes, Cursor, Claude Code, and OpenClaw.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This tool automates skill evolution, deduplication, and quality improvement through an Agentic Evolver. It integrates with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs and provides a dashboard for inspecting session traces.

entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other agents. It extracts transcripts, captions, and timestamps without the use of yt-dlp.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It reports findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe support for agentskills.io using modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
